sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Turbine-Driven Critical Care Invasive Ventilators

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Taiwan (investment destination operating under Taiwan's Company Act and the cross-strait special legal framework; functional sub-tax distinction exists between national and local levies)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Taiwan Company Act and commercial codes of German-Japanese codification lineage with U.S.-influenced AML, securities, and medical-device statutes)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA, signed 2010) - active; provides the formal trade and investment facilitation framework between mainland China and Taiwan
Cross-Strait Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement (signed 2012) - active; governs investor protection, expropriation compensation, and investment dispute resolution
Cross-Strait Avoidance of Double Taxation and Strengthened Tax Cooperation Agreement (signed 2015) - signed but NOT in force; no DTAA relief is available for parent-company remittances at this stage
WTO - Separate Customs Territory of Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu (multilateral obligations relevant to goods and services market access)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Control Act (洗钱防制法) Articles 5, 7-9 with 2018 amendments and Enforcement Rules (beneficial ownership at Article 8, PEP at Article 7); Company Act (公司法) Article 22-1 requiring every company to file its directors, supervisors, managers, and shareholders holding 10% or more with the MOEA platform within 15 days of incorporation and upon any subsequent change; Counter-Terrorism Financing Act (资恐防制法) Articles 4-5 for UN-sanctions implementation and asset freeze; Regulations Governing Permission of Investment in Taiwan by Mainland Chinese Investors (大陆地区人民来台投资许可办法), jointly administered under Article 73 of the Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area; Medical Devices Administration Act (医疗器材管理法), effective 1 May 2021, requiring establishment licensing and QMS certification for the ventilator manufacturing operation; targeted banking guidance confirming a Medium_Risk_Enhanced tier for life-support hardware makers using Government_LC and SWIFT wire payment rails

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Parent Company Business License (营业执照)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (market regulator in the mainland parent's domicile)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait SEF Authentication; mainland notary public attestation followed by Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification certificate; Hague Apostille and Consular Legalization are NOT applicable to Taiwan-bound mainland documents

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (民國公司法), Articles 1, 4, 18, 128, 156, 419 (as amended); Regulations on Foreign Investment Approval by the Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEAIC)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Services (經濟部商業司) via the Company Registration and One-Stop Service Portal; foreign investment approval from the Investment Commission, MOEA
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (公司章程) together with the Company Registration Application Form (公司登記申請書)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Limited Liability Company; however, the paid-in capital must be fully subscribed and deposited into a designated escrow bank account pending company registration, with a bank capital verification certificate required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the Company adopts its Articles of Incorporation and hereby confirms the subscription of shares by the sole Shareholder. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office of the Company shall be established at the address stated in the registration application, and the Company authorizes the filing of all incorporation documents with the competent authority. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the directors and officers named below are appointed effective immediately: Chairperson and General Manager, Chief Financial Officer, and Compliance Officer, each with authority to act within the scope of law and corporate governance. RESOLVED THAT any single officer may execute necessary banking and licensing documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEAIC) - Online Application System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the foreign investment application through MOEAIC's online portal with notarized investor identification documents, a detailed business plan for the manufacture of turbine-driven critical care ventilators, and a declaration of no local security restrictions. Await approval letter, which is a precondition for company registration.
required_dossiers: Notarized Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign investor
Bank reference letter or financial statements
Business plan covering ISIC 3250 medical device manufacturing
Power of attorney to local agent
Investment application form signed by authorized representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If queried, submit supplemental explanation of foreign ownership structure and technology transfer details within 14 days; request reconsideration or file an administrative appeal within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Paid-in Capital Escrow Deposit and Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated commercial bank in Taiwan acting as escrow agent; verification by certified public accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary capital escrow account in the name of the company-to-be-formed, remit foreign currency converted to New Taiwan Dollars, and obtain a bank deposit certificate. Engage a Taiwan CPA to verify capital subscription and issue a capital verification report.
required_dossiers: Foreign exchange purchase and remittance application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If remittance is blocked by foreign exchange controls, confirm the investment approval citation with the bank and request a special foreign exchange permit from the Central Bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs (Company Registration One-Stop Service)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the company registration application electronically, attaching the approved foreign investment letter, Articles of Incorporation, capital verification report, and the pro-forma board resolution. Pay the filing fee online and follow the one-stop integration with the local tax authority for uniform invoice issuance registration.
required_dossiers: Registered office lease or ownership proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is queried due to missing information, provide corrective documents using the online amendment module within 10 business days; re-submit after curing defects to avoid deemed rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Selection and Issuance of Uniform Invoice Number and Tax Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau (regional office) through the one-stop portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The one-stop service automatically assigns a Uniform Invoice Number (統一編號) and registers the company as a profit-seeking enterprise for VAT and income tax. Obtain the tax registration certificate and register for e-invoice issuance capabilities.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is delayed, expedite by submitting a written request to the tax authority with the company registration certificate and proof of office address.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Bank Account Activation and Official Seal Carving
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate banking unit and licensed seal carver registered with the local government
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the company registration certificate and approved by-laws to the bank to convert the escrow account into the company's operating account. Carve the company chop, company manager's chop, and financial seal, and register the seal specimen with the relevant authorities if required for banking.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional beneficial ownership declarations, provide the group structure chart and beneficial ownership declaration under AML rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA) under the Ministry of Health and Welfare; local Department of Economic Development for factory registration
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Device Manufacturer License (GMP / QMS Certificate) and Factory Registration Permit (工廠登記證)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Taiwan Environmental Protection Administration (EPA), Ministry of Environment (MOENV)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - Environmental Impact Assessment Screening Registration (Category C) for medical device manufacturing with low to moderate pollution load, subject to waste and air emissions registration; a full EIA report is not required for this scale, but an environmental review declaration is mandatory.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must meet Effluent Standards (放流水標準) for suspended solids limited to 30 mg/L and chemical oxygen demand to 100 mg/L; VOC fugitive emissions must comply with Taiwan Clean Air Act and emission standards for stationary sources; hazardous waste handling under Waste Management Act with manifests and proper treatment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification per Fire Services Act (消防安全設備檢修及申報), structural load inspection and approval by local government for the factory floor, and occupational safety clearance under OSHA regulations including emergency evacuation plan and periodic workplace safety inspections.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Current-account transactions for goods and services are freely convertible through designative Chinese commercial banks. Capital-account items, including paid-in capital injection, shareholder loans, and profit repatriation, are subject to SAFE registration, prior approval, or post-event filing. Profit and dividend remittance from the WFOE requires audited annual financial statements, corporate income tax clearance, and a valid SAFE FDI registration. Cross-strait remittances to Taiwan are treated as capital flows under the Cross-Strait Financial Cooperation Agreement, requiring additional evidentiary documentation and source-of-funds confirmation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export receipts must be repatriated to a Chinese designated foreign exchange account within a period consistent with trade settlement practice and reported through the SAFE Goods Trade Monitoring System. There is no mandatory selling-to-RMB obligation; however, each export transaction requires reconciliation against customs export declarations (报关单) within 90 days of the export date. Receipts not matched within the statutory verification window become subject to enhanced audit and monetary penalty.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Capital Account (Capital Escrow) & RMB Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Capital Account (Capital Escrow) & RMB Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Capital Account (Capital Escrow) & RMB Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as a stand-alone solution; ACCEPTABLE only as an ancillary payment corridor. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Airwallex, Skyee, WorldFirst) without a PRC banking license cannot hold statutory capital, receive SAFE-registered FDI, or settle government L/C proceeds. Funds collected through such platforms must be routed into a licensed Chinese commercial bank account. Legal constraints: absence of a mainland deposit-taking license, lack of SAFE connectivity for cross-border balance-of-payments reporting, and prohibition on direct RMB conversion by non-bank institutions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for the legal representative and at least two authorized signatories during initial account opening. Remote or video-based opening is not permitted by mainstream Tier1 banks for a first-time corporate account. A notarized and legalized power of attorney may allow a nominated PRC resident to represent an overseas legal representative, but the bank reserves the right to require an in-person interview with the ultimate beneficial owner before the account is activated. Some banks accept online pre-filing of documents but still require an in-branch identity verification step.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign investor is a Taiwan-resident company, creating cross-strait beneficial ownership complexity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized Taiwanese corporate registry extract, share-holding ledger, group structure chart identifying all UBOs, board resolution authorizing the establishment of the WFOE, and proof of Taiwan tax residency.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk business scope: manufacture of ICU ventilators, which may trigger medical-device and export-control screening.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: NMPA Medical Device Registration Certificate, ISO 13485 certification, CE/FDA export licenses, end-user and end-use certificates from each buyer, and quality management system process documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection exceeding USD 5 million from the offshore parent presents source-of-funds enhanced due diligence triggers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited parent company financial statements for the past three years, bank reference letters from the parent's home bank, board-approved capital call resolution, and sworn source-of-wealth declarations for each contributing shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Government L/C proceeds from public hospital purchasers may create PEP and corruption-risk concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original letters of credit, signed hospital procurement contracts, commercial invoices, packing lists, customs export declarations (报关单), and evidence that all counterparties are not PEPs, politically exposed entities, or sanctioned persons.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire transfer protocol: the Taiwan parent initiates an SWIFT MT103 credit to the WFOE's foreign exchange capital account held at a designated Chinese Tier1 bank. Field 70 (Remittance Information) must state the WFOE's FDI Business Registration Certificate Number, the purpose 'Investment – Paid-in Capital', and a reference to the SAFE FDI Registration Code. The Chinese bank verifies (a) the credit amount against the remaining approved registered capital, (b) the authenticity of the underlying FDI Registration, and (c) the corporate resolution authorizing the capital injection. Upon receipt, the bank files a cross-border balance-of-payments report with SAFE and allocates the funds strictly in accordance with the permitted capital-use purposes.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements: (a) SWIFT MT103 direct outward remittances for paying import suppliers, using purpose code 'General Trade Import' with matched customs import declarations; (b) Commercial Letter of Credit (MT700) opened by the WFOE's Chinese bank for bulk purchases of electronic components and subassemblies; (c) For export receipts under government LCs, confirmation and negotiation through the Chinese bank's trade services desk using SWIFT MT710/MT720, with optional forfaiting or discounting of L/C proceeds. All outbound disbursements require underlying contracts, invoices, and customs declarations to satisfy SAFE's trade monitoring requirements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable foreign-exchange forwards (CNY vs USD/EUR/JPY) transacted with Chinese Tier1 banks under real trade-background and approved exposure limits

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (CNY NDF) executed through the Taiwan parent or an authorized offshore broker, subject to documented hedge economic substance and prohibition on offshore speculative settlement
Onshore cross-currency swaps between CNY and USD/EUR for hedging principal and interest of cross-border shareholder loans

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Shareholders' Meeting Resolutions and Financial Statements/Minutes Filing with MOEA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: General meeting must be held within 6 months after fiscal year end; for calendar-year companies, by June 30. Filed minutes to MOEA within 15 days after the meeting.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of NT$10,000–NT$50,000 per violation; continued non-compliance triggers MOEA administrative dissolution or strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return and Supporting Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (Taiwan)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual filing and self-assessment from April 1 to May 31 of the calendar year following the tax year end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of 3% per month up to 9% of the tax payable for late returns; delinquent interest at the Postal Savings Bank one-year deposit rate; possible additional tax investigation and criminal referral for willful evasion.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register Annual Verification and Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs; Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau under AML enforcement; register retained on-site and produced on demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be refreshed no later than the annual general meeting and within 1 month after any change in shareholding or beneficial ownership; confirmation record must be dated and signed.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties up to NT$500,000 under the Money Laundering Control Act and Company Law; responsible persons may face fines and orders to comply; failure to produce registers constitutes continuing AML non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Status Declaration and Compliance Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEAIC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted annually within 3 months after the fiscal year end; for calendar-year entities the filing window ends March 31 or, where tax audited statements are required, May 31.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Sanctions include monetary fines and suspension or revocation of the foreign investment approval; persistent failure can result in administrative deregistration of the WFOE.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Withholding Tax Statements and Remuneration/Payment Registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Finance, National Taxation Bureau (Taiwan)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Withholding statements due by February 1 of the year following the taxable year; extension to February 5 when the statutory deadline falls on a weekend or national holiday.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of the tax withheld per requirement; failure to issue withholding statements results in NT$1,500–NT$15,000 per item and addition of tax to the remitter's own tax liability.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent CPA audit is required when paid-in capital exceeds NT$30 million (approximately US$1 million), or when revenue, bank borrowing, or other thresholds under the Business Entity Accounting Act are met; mandatory for public companies and regulated industries regardless of size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan IFRS/TIFRS as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission for public companies; private companies applying the Business Entity Accounting Act may adopt local GAAP but must follow IFRS if they become audit-threshold entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, at or before the general meeting, directors must confirm and update the beneficial ownership register; any share transfer or change in ultimate beneficial owner must be recorded within one month; the company must retain supporting identification documents and be ready to produce the register to competent authorities on request.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$900–US$2,500 per year for professional registered office and corporate secretary/agent services in Taiwan
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$4,000–US$10,000 per year for a small–medium private company requiring certified CPA audit and related filing statements

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday. Eligible R&D expenditures for the development of invasive ventilators may qualify for an investment tax credit of up to 15% under the Industrial Innovation Act, subject to approval and annual budget caps. Undistributed earnings are subject to a 5% retained-earnings surtax unless fully allocated. Strategic medical-device reinvestment may be eligible for additional case-by-case negotiated incentives.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 75 (Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return), filed electronically through the Taiwan Ministry of Finance e-Filing Portal (https://tax.nat.gov.tw).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return must be filed within five months after the fiscal year-end. For calendar-year entities, the deadline is May 31 of the following year; a one-month extension may be granted upon application.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross sales and revenues, net of returns and allowances.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all Taiwan-source and foreign-source revenue recognized under approved financial reporting standards; do not offset intercompany revenue without transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold, including direct materials, labour, and manufacturing overhead for invasive ventilators.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain a complete cost build-up for intercompany component purchases from all affiliates; the proportion of transfer price to final arm's-length value must be supportable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses, including selling, general, and administrative costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate expenses to Taiwan based on function and risk analysis; cross-border management and technical service fees must be at arm's length and beneficially owned.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after tax adjustments and loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Adjust accounting profit to taxable income in accordance with the Income Tax Act and generally accepted tax accounting principles; undepreciated fixed assets and obsolete inventory must be substantiated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ordinary corporate income tax calculated at 20% of taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 20% statutory rate. Claim eligible investment credits and foreign tax credits only where supported by certificates and tax residence documents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable after provisional tax payments, credits, and withholding taxes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile all provisional payments and credits. Any dividend or royalty withholding tax paid on outbound remittances must be separately reported and cannot be claimed as a credit by the WFOE itself.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: a penalty of 1% of the tax due for each month of delay, up to 30% of the tax due. Late payment: accrued daily interest surcharge of 0.02% (approximately 7.3% annualized) on the outstanding amount, plus an additional late-payment penalty of up to 20% if the tax is not settled after demand. In severe cases, the tax authority may impose a 3× assessment on unreported income.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A non-resident shareholder resident in a Taiwan DTA/ADTA partner may apply for a reduced rate by submitting to the paying entity: (i) a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the counterparty tax authority, (ii) a Form 1101 withholding tax exemption/reduction application through the Taiwan withholding agent, and (iii) supporting beneficial ownership statements. The application must be filed before each distribution. For mainland China shareholders, no DTA is currently in force; the cross-strait tax agreement signed in 2015 remains unimplemented, so the statutory 21% rate applies unless an ad-hoc ruling is obtained.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: royalties 20%, interest 20%. Treaty-reduced rates commonly range between 10% and 15% depending on the DTA. For mainland China, no treaty reduction is presently available, so the statutory 20% rate remains.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: NT$100 million in aggregate annual related-party transaction value. A lower threshold may apply for transactions with related parties in designated low-tax jurisdictions or for intangible-related transactions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan does not maintain a standalone Economic Substance Regulation, but applies substance-over-form and the place-of-effective-management test. A Taiwan WFOE used as a booking pass-through without local premises, employees, inventory risk, or board control is subject to profit reattribution, denial of treaty benefits, and CFC rules. The entity must maintain substantial manufacturing activity, management decisions, and payroll in Taiwan to survive audit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Fabricating purchase invoices, inflating R&D credits, omitting ventilator export revenues from the Form 75 return, or destroying accounting records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of the full underpaid tax, a penalty of 2 to 3 times the underpaid amount, and criminal prosecution under the Income Tax Act and the Criminal Code. Fines may reach NT$10 million, and imprisonment of up to seven years may be ordered for intentional evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly cause or approve fraudulent filings may be personally assessed for the unpaid corporate tax through veil-piercing under the Company Act; travel bans and asset seizure are available; criminal imprisonment applies to responsible officers.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Taiwanese WFOE as a low-substance invoice and booking hub for related-party sale of ventilators, with no real management, manufacturing, or inventory in Taiwan, and diverting profits to zero-tax offshore subsidiaries.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may re-characterize the legal entity, attribute all relevant profits to Taiwan, apply the 20% corporate tax plus a 5% retained-earnings surtax, and impose a 2x penalty on the adjusted underpayment. Benefits of any DTA may be retroactively denied.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be ordered to pay the corporate tax, penalty, and interest if the corporate form was a sham; the tax authority can impose civil restitution, travel bans, and, in egregious cases, prosecution for fraud or money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to conduct customer due diligence on government LC instruments, structuring Swift wire transfers to avoid transaction thresholds, or using shell accounts to obscure the trail of ventilator export proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering Control Act, fines up to NT$100 million and imprisonment up to ten years for willful violations. The tax authority may also assess a 20% to 100% evasion penalty on the underlying unreported income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners face personal criminal liability; assets, including offshore accounts, may be frozen; seizure and confiscation orders may be executed against personal estates.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging non-arm's-length management fees to the Taiwanese manufacturer, underpricing exports to Hong Kong or Shenzhen distribution affiliates, or failing to prepare the master file, local file, and country-by-country report above the NT$100 million threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A transfer-pricing adjustment will increase taxable income and create a 20% to 40% penalty on the additional tax. Failure to file required TP documentation without reasonable cause also triggers a fine of NT$5,000 to NT$100,000 and precludes the taxpayer from invoking the transfer-pricing defense.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers who sign or certify false TP documentation may be jointly liable for the penalty; repeated violations can result in professional disqualification, travel restrictions, and personal civil liability for the tax deficit.
